items.title: AutoTerm-SST: Adaptive Terminology Memory with Zero Session-Time Setup for Streaming Speech Translation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented speech translation improves rare terminology, but systems such as RASST still assume that users provide a glossary before each session. That assumption is inconvenient for live talks, while merging every domain into one growing glossary eventually places too many irrelevant terms in the same retrieval and prompt competition. We present AutoTerm-SST, an interactive system that removes session-time glossary upload and domain selec
items.summary_zh: AutoTerm-SST 提出零会话前置的自适应术语记忆，解决流式语音翻译中术语检索需预先提供词表的痛点。
items.why_zh: 展示流式语音翻译中动态术语检索与自适应记忆机制的工程落地，属 RAG 与实时系统结合技能点。

items.title: Stateful Agentic Engineering Copilots with Letta: Core Memory, Shared State, Semantic Retrieval, Custom Tools, Streaming, and Portable Agent Workflows
items.summary: Discover how to extend agentic memory beyond basic prompts by building a stateful engineering copilot with Letta. This comprehensive guide covers inspectable core memory, archival vector retrieval, multi-agent shared state, custom tools, and portable workflows. The post Stateful Agentic Engineering Copilots with Letta: Core Memory, Shared State, Semantic Retrieval, Custom Tools, Streaming, and Portable Agent Workflows appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Letta 构建有状态工程副驾，提供可检查核心记忆、向量检索、多智能体共享状态、自定义工具与可移植工作流。
items.why_zh: Agent 记忆架构设计，使用核心记忆+向量归档实现长期上下文，配合共享状态实现多 Agent 协作

items.title: Context Engineering (Agent Memory) for AI Agents Starts with Retrieval
items.summary: Agents waste time and context on clumsy searches, oversized results and stale data. Learn the retrieval techniques LangChain's Deep Agents harness uses to get the right context in.
items.summary_zh: LangChain 发布《Context Engineering (Agent Memory) for AI Agents Starts with Retrieval》，介绍 Deep Agents 使用的检索技术以获取精准上下文
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 记忆与检索工程技能点，演示如何用分层检索、缓存与去重提升上下文质量，可直接迁移到自建 Agent 系统

items.title: alkhder at ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks: Constrained Selection and Rotation-Averaged Logit Scoring for Multimodal Hallucination Detection
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe our submission to Subtask~1b of ImageEval 2026. The task consists of selecting the single visually valid statement from three candidates paired with an image, and is in both English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). Our system uses a pre-trained 7B vision--language model in a zero-shot setting, without task-specific training or fine-tuning. items.summary_zh: 团队利用预训练 7B VLM 零样本处理 ImageEval 2026 任务，通过约束选择和旋转平均 Logit 评分检测多模态幻觉。
items.why_zh: 掌握 VLM 零样本微调替代方案，学习 Logit 平均与约束解码技巧，适用于多模态幻觉评估场景。

items.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. items.summary_zh: 提出小模型微调方法解决 RAG 中的查询澄清问题，在多轮对话中优化模糊查询，提升检索精度。
items.why_zh: 涉及 RAG 系统优化与 Few-shot 微调策略，学习如何在小模型上实现高效的对话上下文理解与检索增强。

items.title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents rely on visual history to maintain task states, but retaining historical screenshots increases visual-token usage and inference costs, while textual summaries can discard critical state information, undermining long-horizon reliability. items.summary_zh: ECHOES 通过递归历史压缩和特权在策略蒸馏，减少 GUI 代理的视觉 token 使用同时保留关键状态信息。
items.why_zh: 展示如何利用训练时特权信息进行历史压缩，降低视觉 token 开销，提升长时序任务可靠性，可迁移到多模态代理设计。

items.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
items.summary: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve di
items.summary_zh: Librarian Agents 训练 LLM 主动策划长上下文工作空间，预测未来查询，减少检索延迟。
items.why_zh: 展示如何通过主动上下文策划提升长文档推理，减少实时检索瓶颈，可用于构建预取式 RAG 系统。

items.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
items.summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. items.summary_zh: 研究 RAG 多组件组合时的检索质量与答案忠实度是否保持增益
items.why_zh: 属于 RAG 系统工程技能点，揭示组件组合评测方法与指标设计，指导端到端 RAG 优化

items.title: Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. items.summary_zh: 提出结构化权限注入机制，通过类型化 MCP 覆盖实现跨规划周期持久化的人类控制，解决 LLM Agent 指令模糊问题。
items.why_zh: 涉及 Agent 控制协议设计，可复用 Typed Override 思路解决多 Agent 系统中人类干预的 schema 验证与状态持久化难题。

items.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training

items.why_zh: 演示如何用合成数据与长程 RL 强化 Agent 复杂推理，属 Agent 训练数据构建与评估技能点。

items.title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. items.summary_zh: 论文探讨 LLM 驱动的新一代智能体在智能制造中的应用，针对动态环境、物理约束与可靠性要求提出部署框架。
items.why_zh: 涵盖 Agent 规划、工具调用与工业物理约束融合的工程实践，属具身智能与工业落地技能点。

items.title: The Boring Version of Continual Learning
items.summary: Will Brown of Prime Intellect makes the case that continual learning is about to get boring, in a good way: it is the software development life cycle, applied to models. He traces how agent workflows grow from terminal experiments into production software, why evals should capture the vibe check, and which post-training methods he reaches for, from SFT and on-policy and context distillation to online RL, along with why he is skeptical of jumping straight to OPSD. items.summary_zh: Prime Intellect 的 Will Brown 主张将持续学习视为模型软件开发周期，涵盖 SFT、蒸馏及评估方法。
items.why_zh: 学习 AI 模型运维（MLOps）全生命周期管理，掌握后训练策略选择及评估体系构建的核心工程思维。
